The Patalganga announcement links directly to the earlier buildouts in Rayong, Franklinton, Taicang, Araucaria and West Allis. Large capital projects can overrun and, if demand in India, the Middle East, Africa or Latin America disappoints or local rivals grow faster, the return on that invested capital could end up below what the market currently assumes.
